summary: GI round 4, package PO: second-review offers (engine._routing_agrees, plus new _po_ helpers in validation/engine.py). An unresolved item the installed rule does not offer is OFFERED (the flag only: asking stays a member act, once per revision and date, and nothing is sent by any stage) when routing does not contradict the documented-service reading - PO-1: routing reads the item's family only silently (the minimal design's M1); PO-2: routing's not-today reading of the item's own passage comes only from a section that reaches it across a heading-like line the layout does not read - and the document is today's procedure report by its own head (sections.procedure_report_head, and no title of a note written around a procedure: sections.around_procedure_title). Only the offer flag on unresolved items moves, and only False -> True: no request, date, routing, inventory, proposal, question, check or completeness state. H2 expected delta: NONE.

rule.precondition: an unresolved item (reason no_proposal or not_covered) the installed _routing_agrees does not offer
rule.family_read: routing reads the item's family: at least one mention (never a vacuous family reading)
rule.PO-1: every routing mention of the family is silent (checks.silent, cues never empty), and routing reads no evidence span of the item as not done today or with a worded doubt (each reads silent, or uncertain with only section labels, a performance statement or the family summary UNESTABLISHED)
rule.PO-2: no routing mention of the family contradicts: each reads done today, says nothing (as above), is another occasion's by its own time word (a historical: or planned: cue), or is not today only by its section across an unread heading-like line; every evidence span says nothing or is not today only by its section across an unread heading-like line, and at least one is the latter
rule.section_only_across_unread_heading: status historical or planned; every cue a section label or a performance statement, at least one section label; the section's heading line ends within sections.HEADING_REACH_CHARS characters and sections.HEADING_REACH_LINES lines before the position (beyond_heading_reach's fail-closed True is never read as a found line here: in this direction it would release); sections.beyond_heading_reach True; sections.under_another_occurrence False
rule.not_built: detect_silent: not needed, checks.silent reads the same silence prefix (the validator's own test)

replay.nothing_else: in every member state only these offer flags move: the date channel, requests, routing, the inventory, proposals (bucket, status, fingerprint), questions and completeness are unchanged; h2-10's held-state ERCP offers stay True as installed

offer_battery.about: the H4 rows read twice through jobs._assess_child: with the row's own answer ("own") and with an EMPTY answer ("empty": every documented service done today unresolved); [family, act, reason, installed offer, PO offer] per unresolved item, in completeness order
moving: S3h h4-05 counterfactual, EUS code citing the narrative
S3h h4-05 counterfactual, EUS code citing the narrative

offer_corpus.about: the H2 corpus (regression texts, generated corpus, seeded families, repository texts) plus the H4 rows, 5,768 distinct texts, each in two member states (none; the truth's own date) x two synthetic answers (empty; the base diagnostic code of every family the inventory reads done today, citing the first line); predicted from the INSTALLED facts with the stated rule before the code

pins: tests/fixtures/gi4/pins/replay.json moves by exactly the replay offers above; cues.json, freeze.json, battery.json and tables.json unchanged apart from meta.commit (re-pinned in a separate final commit)
